in_sanskrit.name: Jethu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Younger brother
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jethu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jethu is a Marathi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'jata', which means 'born'. It is used to address a younger brother. In Hindu mythology, Jethu is associated with Lord Vishnu and represents love, kindness, and care towards younger siblings.

It is used to address a younger brother. In Hindu mythology, Jethu is associated with Lord Vishnu and represents love, kindness, and care towards younger siblings.
